newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bank lending up 2.9 pct Jan-Sept - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy bank lending up 2.9 pct Jan-Sept - Ciampi.

text.p: Italian bank lending rose 2.9 percent in the first nine months of the year, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Thursday.

In the three year period between 1993 and 1995 bank lending rose an annual average 2.0 percent. Ciampi said the slow growth rate was not so much due to the state of the economy as to a growing tendency among firms to reduce their banking debts.
The Treasury minister said losses in the banking sector over the past three years amounted to 46 trillion lire.
Ciampi said bad loans rose 15 percent year-on-year in August with the ratio between bad loans and all loans climbing above the 10 percent threshold. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
